deferral_rationale: Severity downgrade BLOCKER->non-blocking (reconciler tie-break, r1): the synchronous unbounded push inside fatal() is byte-identical to approved plan v3 section 1a's prescribed code (plan lines 70-77), so the diff cannot be bounced for implementing it; the same untimed telegram_push.sh call already exists on this wrapper's pre-existing rc=3 arm and ~8 sibling cron wrappers (Codex's own sweep concedes pre-existing family debt), and the shared root cause (curl with no --connect-timeout/--max-time at ~/my-goat/scripts/telegram_push.sh:52) sits outside this repo's diff scope. Worst case requires unwritable-log-infra AND a stalled-but-connected Telegram endpoint simultaneously, and the durable stderr FATAL line is written BEFORE the push, so even the hung case is strictly louder than the pre-fix silent exit 0. Right vehicle: the class-level follow-up fixing telegram_push.sh curl timeouts at the shared root (covers all ~9 call sites), per the Claude verdict's standing recommendation.
